# 크래프트얍 (CraftYap)

> 크래프트얍(CraftYap)은 https://craftyap.com/ 에서 설치 없이 즐기는 무료 3D 웹 블록 게임입니다.

## Official sources

- [게임 시작 / Play](https://craftyap.com/): Official game homepage. Korean name: 크래프트얍. English name: CraftYap.
- [게임 소개·조작법·교실 이용 안내](https://craftyap.com/guide/): Game modes, desktop controls, classroom participation, local and server saves, and frequently asked questions. Includes an English overview.

## Game facts

- Free to play in a browser, with JavaScript and WebGL. No separate game installation or account registration.
- Craft Island: single-player voxel sandbox, mining, building, furniture, pets, and a machine workshop for cars and aircraft.
- Education mode: an endless building field, solo or shared through named classrooms. Teachers create a class; students join using its class name.
- Daily Tower: multiplayer obstacle tower with a new layout each day at midnight Korea Standard Time.
- Robo Builder: idle landmark construction.
- Blast Royale: single-player battle royale against seven robot bots.
- Block building and the machine workshop require a desktop keyboard and mouse. Daily Tower has mobile controls; mobile support does not apply to every mode.
- Solo sandbox and builder saves are stored in the current browser; shared classroom worlds are saved on the server. Browser saves do not automatically sync across devices.

The full public guide is the source of truth for details. This file is a navigation aid for automated readers, not a guarantee of search visibility or AI citation.
